description: Vega 6.4.0's geoTranslate (vega/vega#4313): a projection's translation, which is what pan and zoom on a fitted map start from. Asked of a projection fitted to data, one given its translate, an identity, a composite albersUsa and an unfitted mercator, then used to place a mark. geoScale is asked of the albersUsa too, which this engine answered with null until geoTranslate needed the same lookup.

text.signal: geoTranslate('fitted') + ' | ' + geoTranslate('declared') + ' | ' + geoTranslate('flat') + ' | ' + geoTranslate('states') + ' ' + geoScale('states') + ' | ' + geoTranslate('plain') + ' ' + geoScale('plain') + ' | ' + geoScale('fitted')
